༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba snying po'i rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad sel ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba snying po'i rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad sel ba bzhugs/

bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la don rnam pa gsum ste/ brjod bya rtogs pa'i yan lag tu mtshan gyi don bshad pa/ brjod bya nyid gsal bar ston pa rgyud kyi don dngos bshad pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mtshan gyi don dngos dang*/ phyag gis mchod par brjod pa'o/ /rgyud don dngos la gsum ste/ gzhi lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor/ de las zhi khro gnyis kyi 'char tshul/ rgyud rjes 'jug la gtad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dbyings las ma g.yos par rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bkod tshul/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par ched du brjod tshul/ 'jig rten du sgron ma bkod de chos thams cad gtan la phab tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gleng gzhi mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ rang snang du don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ longs sku'i ngo bo mdor bstan pa dang*/ dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum ste/ gnas/ ston pa/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /gnas la gsum ste/ zhing khams/ gzhal yas khang*/ rgyan dang khri bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /ston pa la gnyis te/ bzhugs tshul thun mong du bstan pa dang*/ yab yum so sor bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum ste/ rgyal tshabs kyi yab lnga/ de'i yum lnga/ rang bzhin ji ltar bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor la gsum/ nang gi sems dpa' yab dang yum/ phyi'i sems dpa' yab dang yum/ sgo ba yab dang yum mo/ /gsum pa rang snang du don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ gang gnyis pa chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par ched du brjod tshul la gnyis te/ la bkod pa'i ngo bo/ ji ltar bkod pa'i tshul lo/ /le'u dang po'o/ /dgongs pa gleng bslang ba dang*/ ma rtogs pa'i sems can la thugs rje g.yo ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gleng ba'i rgyu dang*/

gleng ba dngos kyis yab kyi dgongs pa gleng bslang ba dang*/ gleng ba'i rgyu dang*/ gleng ba dngos kyis yum gyi dgongs pa gleng bslang ba dang*/ gleng ba'i rgyu dang*/ gleng ba dngos gyis gnyis su med pa'i dgongs pa gleng bslang ba'o/ /thugs rje g.yo tshul la lnga ste/ gzhi ye nas gsang bas sems can gyis ma rtog pa/ ma rig pa'i sems can la thugs rje skye tshul/ bdag tu bzung bas 'khor bar 'khrul tshul/ 'khrul dus de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos pa'i tshul/ ye nas grol ba'i chos ston tshul lo/ / le'u gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa 'jig rten du sgron ma bkod pa la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel 'god/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ spyir bstan/ bye brag tu bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ bsod nams chen pos 'dul ba/ mngon par shes pas 'dul ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'dul ba/ theg pa lngas 'dul ba'o/ /de la gsum ste/ theg pa'i dbye ba/ gnyen por gsungs tshul/ de'i don bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin skye med du bstan pa dang*/ chos kyi rang bzhin brjod med du bstan pa'o/ /dang po la drug ste/ 'brel 'god pa/ 'khor bar 'khrul tshul/ rang bzhin chos nyid du bstan pa/ 'khrul snang sems su bstan pa 'khrul rtog rtsa bral du bstan pa/ rnam shes ye shes su bstan pa'o/ / gnyis pa chos kyi rang bzhin brjod med du bstan pa la drug ste/ theg pa bzhi'i 'bras bur bstan pa/ rang bzhin med pa'i cho 'phrul du bstan pa/ gang la gang 'dul du bstan pa/ theg pa kun gyi 'phro gzhir bstan pa/ mdo rgyud kun gyi spyi 'grel du bstan pa/ gnas lugs brjod med du bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ rang snang du ston pa'i rgyu brjod pa dang*/ ji ltar bstan pa dngos so/

/gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'khrul snang sems kyi rang snang du bstan pa/ zhing snang ye shes kyi rang snang du bstan pa'o/ /le'u gsum pa'o/ /don gnyis pa/ de las zhi khro gnyis kyi 'char tshul bstan pa la gnyis te/ zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang*/ khro bo mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gzhi dkyil 'khor bskyed cing dbang bskur ba/ lam bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa/ 'bras bu sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la bstod pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rang bzhin spyir bstan pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i thabs bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyu yi ge sprin gyi dkyil 'khor/ de las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor/ de gsal bar byed pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ yi ge sprin gyi dkyil 'khor dgod pa dang*/ ji ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel 'god/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ yi ge'i rang bzhin spyir bstan/ lha dang sbyar te so sor bshad/ de'i don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ bsgom pa'i tshul/ spros pa'i tshul/ gsungs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ de'i phan yon no/ /spros tshul la gnyis te/ ji ltar spros pa dang*/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas so/ /gsungs tshul la drug ste/ gsungs pa'i rgyu brjod/ chos kyi skur bstan/ longs skur bstan/ sprul skur bstan/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs tshul bstan/ nges tshig bshad pa'o/ /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ tshig gi 'byung khungs bstan pa dang*/ rol pa sprul skur bstan pa'o/ /nges tshig la gsum ste/ skye ba med pa/ lhun gyis grub pa/ gang gis bkod pa'o/ /gnyis pa lha dang sbyar te bshad pa la gsum ste/ spyir bstan pa/ bye brag tu bshad/

don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ dbyings rigs lnga yab yum/ nang sems sgo ba/ phyi sems sgo ma/ ye shes thub pa/ sgo skyong khro bo dang bcas pa'i yi ge'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ kun tu bzang mo'i yi ge /rigs lnga yab kyi yi ge rigs lnga yum gyi yi ge'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dbang po'i sems dpa' bzhi thugs kyi sgo ba dang bcas pa'i yi ge dang*/ yul gyi sems ma bzhi sku yi sgo ba dang bcas pa'i yi ge'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ sems dpa' sgo ba dang*/ sems ma sgo ma dang bcas pa'i yi ge'o/ /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ ye shes kun tu bzang po'i yi ge dang*/ sprul sku thub pa drug gi yi ge'o/ /lnga pa la gnyis te/ sgo skyong dang*/ khro bo'i yi ge'o/ / gsum pa don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ ji ltar byung ba dang*/ bsdu ba dngos so/ / le'u bzhi pa'o/ /gnyis pa ji ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel dgod/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gang sgrub pa'i dngos grub/ yi ge sprin gyi rang bzhin/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i thabs so/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ sems nyid rtsa bar bstan pa/ des grub pa mchog gi dngos grub/ thun mong gi dngos grub/ 'grub pa'i dpe'o/ /yi ge sprin gyi rang bzhin la gnyis te/ gang gis sgrub pa dang*/ ngo bo gang bsgrub pa'o/ /ji ltar sgrub pa'i thabs la gsum ste/ bstan/ bshad/ bsdu ba'o/ / bshad pa la gnyis te/ dmigs med spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pas shes rab stong pa nyid/ bskyed rdzogs lha yi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ snang srid kun tu bzang po'i phyag rgyar bshad pas thabs snang ba bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /le'u lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ dbyings ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor spyir bstan pa dang*/ de'i yan lag sngags dang phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bye brag tu bshad pa'o/

/dang po la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor spro ba'i rgyu brjod pa dang*/ 'phros pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum ste/ lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor spyir bstan/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bye brag tu bshad/ ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor du don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor dngos dang*/ des grub pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ brten pa lha yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gzhal yas khang*/ rgyan/ gdan khri'o/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor la drug ste/ bzhugs tshul/ gang du bzhugs/ phyag mtshan/ sku mdog /rnam pa/ 'od zer ro/ /gnyis pa de sgrub pa'i 'bras bu la bzhi ste/ sku'i 'char tshul/ phrin las mdzad tshul/ 'gro ba grol tshul/ ltas kyi snang tshul lo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gang las byung ba'i dbyings dang*/ de las byung ba'i phrin las so/ /de la bzhi ste/ 'gro drug tha mal/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ sar gnas la snang tshul lo/ /gsum pa grol tshul la gnyis te/ rgyu lam gyis sgrib pa sbyangs tshul dang*/ 'bras bu sku dang sa yi thob tshul lo/ /de la gsum ste/ spyir bstan/bye brag tu bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ /gsum pa ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor du don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ ji ltar gsungs pa dang*/ gang gsungs pa'o/ /le'u drug pa'o/ /gnyis pa sngags dang phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/gsung gsang sngags dang*/ sku phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyu brjod/ dngos bstan/ gtan la dbab pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ gzhal yas khang*/ lha/ phrin las rdzogs pa'i sngags/ ltas snang ba'o/ /lha bskyed pa'i sngags la drug ste/ rigs lnga yab yum thugs kyi sems dpa' yab yum/ sgo ba yab yum/ kun tu bzang po yab yum/ thub pa drug gi sngags so/

/gsum pa phrin las kyi sngags la gsum ste/ spyan drangs zhing bstim pa dang*/ rig pa'i me tog dor ba dang*/ dngos grub kyi don du gsol ba gdab pa'i sngags so/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba'i sngags la gnyis te/ gsung pa'i tshul dang*/ gang gsung ba'o/ /de la gsum ste/ ye shes lnga'i sngags/ byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags/ byin rlabs kyi snang tshul lo/ /gsum pa gtan la dbab pa la lnga ste/ ngo bo brjod med/ rang bzhin bsam med/ gnas lugs rnam dgasnang lugs mchog gyur/ yin lugs gdod ma'o/ /de la gsum ste/ ngo bo gcig las ma 'das pa/ rol pa sna tshogs su 'char ba/ gdul bya'i mos pa la snang ba'o/ /le'u bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa sku phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor spro ba dang*/ spros pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de la gsum ste/ gzhi lam 'bras bu phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ phyag rgya'i rgyu/ spyi'i phyag rgya/ so so'i phyag rgya'o/ /de la lnga ste/ rnam snang*/ mi bskyod/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub yab yum ste rigs lnga yab yum/ sems dpa' yab yum/ sgo ba yab yum/ thub pa drug kun bzang yab yum gyi phyag rgya'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor la gsum ste/ gnas lugs kyi phyag rgya spyir bstan/ snang byed kyi phyag rgya bye brag tu bshad/ 'bras bu'i phyag rgyas mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ stong*/ nyi khri chig stong*/ bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /gsum pa don mdzad la lnga ste/ sna tshogs su spros pa/ de gnyis 'gro la snang tshul/ snang yang gcig las ma g.yos pa/ grangs tshad med pa/ thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bstan pa'o/ /le'u brgyad pa'o/ /gsum pa de gsal bar byed pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ gsungs tshul mdor bstan pa dang*/ rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum ste/ rab mchog dbang*/

dman pa rdul tshon/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ yum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ yab kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor dgod cing mchod pa/ dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ sbyin sreg go /dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor bya dang*/ mchod pa bsham pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ gnas/ tshad/ thig bri ba/ mtshan ma dgod pa'o/ /gnyis pa sbyin sreg la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa mchod pa la gnyis te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa dang*/ bde ba chen po'i mchod pa'o/ /dang po kun rdzob sgyu ma'i mchod pa dngos dang*/ ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul gyis chos can gyi mchod pa dang*/ chos nyid don dam pa'i mchod pa'o/ /gnyis pa bde ba chen po'i mchod pa la gnyis te/ thabs dang*/ shes rab bde ba chen po'i mchod pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ phan yon no/ /de la gnyis te/ rgyal ba mnyes pa dang 'gro ba tshim pas gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi phan yon no/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba la gnyis te/ 'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o/ /de la gnyis te/ yon 'bul ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o/ /gnyis pa rdul tshon du dbang bskur ba la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor bri ba/ bsgrub pa/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor chung ngu dang*/ 'bring*/ chen po thun mong du bri ba'i cho ga'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sa chog dang*/ bri ba'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ spyan drangs pa/ bstim pa'o/ gsum pa 'bras bu la gsum ste/ dpe/ don/ gzhan don 'byung ba gsum gyis gzhan don sems las 'byung ba'i 'thad pa dang*/ ji ltar bsgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ thabs des grub pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de la gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'o/ /de la gsum ste/

sku dang ye shes su grub tshul/ nang gsal chos skur bzhugs tshul/ slar yang sprul sku 'byung tshul lo/ /le'u dgu pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba'i thabs bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ 'jug pa'i tshul bstan pa dang*/ de'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum ste/ nus pa dang*/ phan pa'i dbang dang*/ phan yon no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ zab dbang spyir bstan/ nus dbang bye brag tu bshad/ dbang dang mi ldan pa'i skyon bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ ting nge 'dzin dang rjes gnang gi nyan pa'i dbang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang rjes gnang gi bsgom pa'i dbang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang rjes gnang gi phrin las kyi dbang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang rjes gnang gi 'chad pa'i dbang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang rjes gnang gi rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang ngo*/ /gsum pa phan yon la gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug go /le'u bcu pa'o/ /gnyis pa lam bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pa gnyis te/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim mo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i yan lag go /dang po la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel 'god/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor shes par bya ba dang*/ lam thabs dang shes rab kyi dkyil 'khor nyams su blangs ba'o/ /de la gsum ste/ cir snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ rol pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor/ gang sgrub thabs kyi yan lag go /dang po la gnyis te/ snang sems gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sbyor sgrol gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /dang po la gsum ste/ zhi ba dang khro bos 'dzin byed yab kyi dkyil 'khor/ zhi ba dang khro bos gzung yul yum gyi dkyil 'khor/ rol pa gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /sbyor sgrol gnyis med la gsum ste/ bde chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor/ thabs chen po gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor/

ye shes sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dang po la gsum ste/ sbyar ba'i yul/ tshul ji ltar sbyor ba/ de'i phan yon no/ /thabs chen po gsang ba la gsum ste/ gang bsgral ba'i yul/ ji ltar sgrol ba'i thabs/ nyes pas mi gos pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /gnyis pa rol pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ kun tu bzang po dang*/ dkyil 'khor so so'i tshogs mchod do/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rang bzhin shes par bya ba/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i thabs

/ de'i 'bras bu'o/ /dkyil 'khor so so la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ sgrub pa'o/ dang po la gnyis te/ tshom bu lnga pa gsum pa gcig pas zhi ba dang*/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de sgrub pa la bzhi ste/ gang zag gang gis dkyil 'khor gang bsgrub pa'i tshom bu gcig pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ lnga ba dang*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor ji ltar sgrub pa'o/ / gsum pa gang sgrub thabs kyi yan lag la gsum ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lagamathun pa rkyen gyi yan lag 'grub pa dus kyi yan lag go /le'u bcu gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa de'i yan lag la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel 'god/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ spyir bstan/ bye brag tu bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa'o/ /de la lnga ste/ bro gar gyi ting nge 'dzin phan yon dang bcas pa/ glu'i ting nge 'dzin/ rgyan gos kyi/ bza' btung gi sbyor sgrol gyi ting nge 'dzin phan yon dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum ste/ rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i rgyu/ des grub pa gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'o//gsum pa don bsdu ba la gsum ste/ kun tu bzang po'i bskyed rdzogs/ tshul des dkyil 'khor kun 'grub pa/ phra mo'i nyes pas mi gos pa'o/ /le'u bcu gnyis pa'o/ / gnyis pa rdzogs rim la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel 'god/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ don ngos bzung*/ de gang gis mtshon/ gang la gnas pa'o/ /bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum ste/ zab don dngos/ khyad par 'phags tshul/ gdams pa'i snod bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa/ shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ gnyis med 'od gsal gyi rim pa'o/

/gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ lta bas thag bcad cing sgom pas nyams su blang bas phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan pa dang*/ bsgom tshul dang 'bras bu'i sgo nas nang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa dang*/ 'od gsal ngos bzung zhing de nyid ngo sprad pa'i 'bras bu'i gsang ba 'od gsal gyi rim pa dang sbyar te bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par 'phags tshul la gsum ste/ gang zag gi che ba/ lam gyi che ba/ che ba de las gzhan med pa'o/ /gsum pa gdams pa'i snod la gnyis te/ skal ldan dang*/ skal med do/ /le'u bcu gsum pa'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin la bstod pa la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel 'god/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ spyir bstod pa dang*/ bye brag tu bstod pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ sku/ gsung*/ thugs/ yon tan/ phrin las la bstod pa'o/ /le'u bcu bzhi pa'o/ /don gnyis pa khro bo mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa la gsum ste/ gzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin/ lam ji ltar sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'bras bu sku dang ye shes la bstod pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gdul bya las kyi khro bo'i byung tshul dang*/ 'dul byed ye shes kyi khro bos btul tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dgos ched dri ba dang*/ lan bshad pa'o/ /de la gnyis te/ rgyu gang gis bskyed pa dang*/ 'bras bu gang smin pa'o/ /de la gnyis te/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags su skyes pas rnam smin gyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal myong ba dang*/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu gzhan la 'tshe ba'o/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi khro bos btul tshul la gnyis te/ gdul bya gzigs tshul dang*/ btul ba dngos so/ /de la gsum ste/ cho 'phrul bzhis dregs pa can zil gyis mnan pa/ phrin las drag pos gdug pa can tshar bcad pa/ thugs rjes rjes su bzung nas bka' la btags pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/

rgyu ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ de las cho 'phrul spros pa'o/ /gnyis pa tshar bcad pa la bzhi ste/ gtso bo dang 'khor bkod pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bkod pa/ dregs pa can rngam sgras rgol ba dang de bsgral bas pho rgyud dngos su bsgral ba/ snod dang bcud kyi 'jig rten bsdu ba dang sbyor ba chen po'i rol pas mo rgyud sbyor bas dgyes pa/ spro ba'i sbyor ba dang*/ ma mo spros pa dang*/ phra men spros pa dang 'khor rnams rang gi gnas su btang bas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor spro ba'o/ / gsum pa thugs rjes bzung ba la bzhi ste/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas/ dregs pa can phyung ste khrus byas shing dkyil 'khor gyi zhal bstan pas gnas spar te dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i tshul bstan pa dang*/ stong khams mnyam du btul ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gdan du phul ba dang*/ 'khor phul ba/ dam bcas pa/ dbang mo 'bangs su 'ong bas dregs pa can gyi 'bangs su khas blang ba dang*/ dbang bskur te bka' bsgo ba'o/ /le'u bco lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa lam ji ltar sgrub pa'i thabs la lnga ste/ thugs rgyud bskul ba gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor/ dmigs pa'i rten gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor/ ji ltar mchod pa'i tshul/ dam tshig gi rim pa/ phrin las sgrub pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ mjug bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ gtso bo yab yum/ ma mo brgyad/ phra men brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi/ dbang mo nyer brgyad bskyed pas lha bskyed pa'i sngags dang*/ ye shes spyan drangs pa'i sngags dang*/ rig pa'i me tog dor ba'i sngags dang*/ dngos grub kyi don du gsol ba gdab pa'i sngags dang*/ phrin las kyi don du gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags so/ /le'u bcu drug pa'o/ /gnyis pa dmigs pa'i rten gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la gsum ste/ rgyu spyir bstan/ rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/ ltas snang ba'o/

/gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gzhal yas khang dang*/ rgyan dang*/ gdan khri ste rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ brten pa lha yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de la gnyis te/ sku mdog zhal phyag gi rnam pa/ rgyan cha/ gsung gi nga ro/ phyag mtshan btsun mo'i sbyor tshul dang bcas pas gtso bo'i bzhugs tshul dang*/ khro mo nyi shu dang dbang mo nyer brgyad kyis 'khor gyi bkod pa'o/ /le'u bcu bdun pa'o/ /gsum pa ji ltar mchod pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel 'god/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sgrol ba dang sbyor bas spyir bstan/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi dang 'dod yon rgyan gyi mchod pas bye brag tu bshad/ thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub 'grub bas phan yon bstan pa'o/ /le'u bco brgyad pa'o/ /bzhi pa dam tshig gi rim pa la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel dgod/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dam tshig chen po'i ngo bo spyir bstan pa dang*/ bsgrub bsrung gi rnam bzhag bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ gsang ba'i dam tshig gzhan las 'phags tshul/ der 'dul sdom thams cad 'dus tshul/ dam tshig dngos so/ / de la bzhi ste srog gcod/ ma byin len/ rdzun smra/ mi tshangs spyod do/ gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la bzhi ste/ ngo bo nges tshig dang bcas pa/ phan yon nyes dmigs dang bcas pa/ rang bzhin dbye ba dang bcas pa/ phan yon chen po rgya cher bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rtsa ba dang mi spang zhing dang blang gi yan lag ste ngo bo dang*/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nges tshig go /gnyis pa phan yon nyes dmigs bcas pa la gnyis te/ bsrung ba'i phan yon dang*/ nyams pa'i nyes dmigs so/ /de la gnyis te/ rtsa ba nyams pa'i nyams grib gzhan la gnod cing rang la 'byung ba dang*/ yan lag nyams pa'i nyes pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ rang bzhin dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /de la gnyis te/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dbye bas rnam grangs kyi dbye ba dang*/

chos can dang chod nyid mtha' med pas dam tshig bsam gyis mi khyab par dbye ba'o/ /bzhi pa phan yon rgya cher bshad pa la lnga ste/ 'jig rten pas bstod cing bskur ba/ 'phags pas byin gyis rlob pa/ rgyal ba'i spyod yul thob pa/ 'dul sdom dam tshig 'dus pa/ nyams kyang gsor rung ba'o/ /le'u bcu dgu pa'o/ /lnga pa phrin las sgrub pa la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel 'god/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ spyir bstan/ bye brag tu bshad/ khyad par gzhan smos pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ drag po/ dbang*/ rgyas pa/ zhi ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ sreg pa me yi las/ gdab pa phur bu'i las/ mnan pa bro yi las so/ /dbang la gsum ste/ sreg /gdab/ mnan pa'o/ /rgyas pa la gsum ste/ sreg /gdab/ mnan pa'o/ /zhi ba la gsum ste/ sreg /gdab/ mnan pa'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ dam can la bka' bsgo ba dang*/ bro gar gyi phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bka' bsgo ba'i tshul dang*/ bsgo ba dngos so/ / phan yon la gnyis te/ don ngos bzung ba dang*/ de rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la bzhi ste/ gtso bo lnga yi bro gar gyi phan yon/ ma mo brgyad kyi= phra men brgyad kyi= dbang mo nyer brgyad kyi bro gar gyi phan yon no/ /gsum pa khyad par gzhan smos pa la gnyis te/ gnas dang*/ ting nge 'dzin no/ /le'u nyi shu pa'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu sku dang ye shes la bstod pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ bstod tshul mdor bstan pa dang*/ bstod pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gnyis te/ rigs lnga spyir bstod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug la bye brag tu bstod pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ sku yi/ gsung gi thugs kyi/ yon tanakyi/ phrin las kyi rigs la bstod pa'o/ /le'u nyer gcig pa'o/ /don gsum pa rgyud rjes 'jug la gtad pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel 'god/tshig gi don bshad/

skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lam kun gyi 'bras bur gdams pa dang*/ gsang ba kun gyi mchog tu gdams pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gdams bya rgyud kyi rang bzhin dang*/ gang la gdams pa snod kyi che ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'bras rgyud dngos bstan/ lam gzhan de'i rkang stegs su bstan/ rnam grangs gzhan gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsang ba kun gyi mchog tu gdams pa la gnyis te/ gsang don dngos dang*/ de 'dzin pa'i gang zag lung bstan pa'o/ / gsum pa skabs kyi don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ rang snang la dgyes pa dang*/ rang snang gdod ma'i dbyings de nyid du 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs tshul lo/ /le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don la gsum ste/ rgyud gang gi khongs su gtogs pa dang*/ le lag gang yin pa/ 'bras bu mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /bdag blo'i yid kyi padmo'i khang bzang du/ /rgyud don sgyu 'phrul nyi zer gsal ba yis/ /bsdus 'grel 'dab stong ge sar rgyas gyur pa/ /de yis blo gsal rkang drug dga' bar mdzod/ /dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ ma lus nyer zhi gdod ma'i mkha' dbyings su/ /gsang ba'i snying po dam pas legs gzhol te/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par shog /gang 'dir bdag blo nags ri'i khrod dga' zhing*/ /spros pas skyo la ting 'dzin lhur len na'ang*/ /yang yang bskul phyir snying rje'i rlabs g.yo bas/ /phyi rabs don 'gyur snyam nas 'di brtsams so/ /mig ldan rnams kyi gzu bo'i blos sbyar te/ /ji bzhin don nyid gzigs pas dgongs par 'gyur/ /lung rigs man ngag rnam bkra'i tshogs mang bas/ /cung zad mi 'gal legs bshad sprin phung 'khrigs/ /'di don rnam bzhi'i legs par bstan pa ni/ /spyi don yid mkha'i mun pa sel ba dang*/ /bsdus don ma rig mun pa sel ba dang*/ /gzhung don phyogs bcu'i mun pa sel ba dang*/

/lam rim ye shes sgron ma 'bar ba ste/ /theg mchog sgyu 'phrul tshig don gsal ba yin/ /rin chen mchog las 'dod dgu sgrub pa bzhin/ /rgyud don mchog las thar pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /blo mig mchog las phun tshogs sgrub pa dang*/ /legs bshad mchog las don gnyis sgrub par mdzod/ /'dir ni skye bo dga' ba rnam mang bas/ /dad ldan don gnyer dga' bas dgyes par mdzod/ /dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i bsdus don ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad sel ba zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa rdo rje gzi brjid kyis/ gangs ri thod dkar du sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) dpal gsang ba snying po'i bsdus don ma rig mun sel/ -PAGE 200--PAGE 201--PAGE 184-
